documents.title: Print a Learner Profile
documents.text: print a learner profile write a standalone kotlin program that prints your name learning goal and current week on separate lines with one comment explaining why the program exists. execution starts in main and the source compiles. the three output lines appear in the intended order. one comment explains intent and produces no output.

documents.title: Model an Expense
documents.text: model an expense represent a category quantity unit price and approval limit with well named kotlin values. calculate the total and print a readable summary using string templates. declarations use suitable inferred or explicit types. val is used unless reassignment is genuinely necessary. the total is calculated once and reused in output.

documents.title: Decide an Expense Status
documents.text: decide an expense status given an amount category and receipt flag calculate named boolean facts and use when to produce blocked receipt required or ready. independent rules have descriptive boolean names. invalid input is checked before broader approval rules. exactly one status is produced for every input combination.

documents.title: Summarise a Week of Expenses
documents.text: summarise a week of expenses iterate over seven daily amounts reject zero or negative entries and calculate both the accepted total and accepted count. iteration boundaries cover each amount exactly once. only the two required accumulators are mutable. the final output reports both total and count.

documents.title: Extract Expense Functions
documents.text: extract expense functions refactor an expense script into separate functions for validation total calculation and summary formatting leaving main to coordinate them. every function has focused parameters and a clear return type. business functions return results rather than printing. the main function reads as a short sequence of meaningful calls.

documents.title: Parse Uncertain Amounts
documents.text: parse uncertain amounts create a function that accepts nullable text safely parses a positive amount and returns null when the input is absent non numeric zero or negative. no not null assertion or throwing numeric conversion is used. parsing and positive value validation are both performed. the caller handles success and absence explicitly.

documents.title: Week 1 Expense Entry
documents.text: week 1 expense entry build the week 1 command line expense entry normalise and parse amount text validate amount and category calculate a summary and present a clear success or failure result. the program has explicit examples for every required failure path. parsing validation and formatting are separate focused functions. invalid external text cannot crash the program. a manual trace documents data at every pipeline stage.

documents.title: Model an Expense Recorder
documents.text: model an expense recorder build expense expensestore inmemoryexpensestore and expenserecorder so invalid expenses cannot be created and storage can be replaced. expense construction rejects blank categories and non positive amounts. recorder depends on expensestore rather than a concrete list. the in memory implementation does not expose its mutable collection.

documents.title: Model Expense Entry State
documents.text: model expense entry state create an immutable draft a category enum with stable codes and a sealed validation result that lists every failure or carries a valid expense. draft updates use copy rather than public mutation. category persistence does not depend on enum ordinal. validation result handling is exhaustive without a catch all else.

documents.title: Build an Expense Report Pipeline
documents.text: build an expense report pipeline transform a list of expenses into totals by category highest expense unique categories and a sorted list of positive records. every requested output uses a collection operation whose result type fits the requirement. the source list is not mutated. empty input is handled without an unexpected exception.

documents.title: Create Reusable Expense Policies
documents.text: create reusable expense policies add parsing and formatting extensions plus a higher order report function that accepts different expense selection policies. function types make selection policy explicit. extensions remain focused and have narrow visibility. the solution avoids nested scope function chains.

documents.title: Design Save Outcomes
documents.text: design save outcomes refactor an expense save function so validation successful storage and i o failure are distinct explicit outcomes with preserved diagnostics. expected invalid data does not throw. only the anticipated storage exception is translated. every outcome is handled exhaustively by the caller.

documents.title: Create Typed Import Sources
documents.text: create typed import sources design generic source and sink apis for importing expenses with variance that allows specialised producers and broad consumers safely. no unchecked cast is required. producer and consumer directions match their declarations. a specialised expense source can copy into a sink that accepts any.

documents.title: Add Typed IDs and Store Logging
documents.text: add typed ids and store logging introduce expenseid as a validated value class and wrap an expensestore using class delegation to add focused logging. expenseid cannot be confused with another string based identifier. unchanged store operations delegate automatically. the logging wrapper preserves the underlying failure behaviour.

documents.title: Create an Expense Report Builder
documents.text: create an expense report builder design a small receiver based builder that validates expenses prevents nested receiver confusion and returns a read only report. the dsl marker constrains nested receiver scope. invalid expenses cannot enter the built report. the returned model does not expose builder mutation.

documents.title: Harden a Java Boundary
documents.text: harden a java boundary write a kotlin adapter around a hypothetical java expense record with platform strings and boxed numbers producing a validated immutable kotlin model. platform values do not escape the adapter. nullability and conversion failures become explicit outcomes. no non null assertion is used for uncertain java data.

documents.title: Build a Safe Project Inspector
documents.text: build a safe project inspector write a small shell checklist or script that confirms it is inside the droidquest data directory reports relevant json file counts and runs content validation without modifying files. the working directory is checked before relative paths are used. a failed validation produces a non zero final status. the script performs no destructive operation.

documents.title: Prepare a Reviewable Change
documents.text: prepare a reviewable change create a branch and a documentation only commit that explains how to validate droidquest content then draft a pull request description with purpose evidence and risks. the staged diff contains only the intended documentation. the commit message states the resulting outcome. the pull request draft includes commands run and manual review notes.

documents.title: Diagnose a Failing Import
documents.text: diagnose a failing import given a small expense import program and a repeatable exception write a debugging record containing reproduction stack trace interpretation one hypothesis experiment repair and regression checks. the first wrong state is distinguished from the final symptom. only one hypothesis is tested in the experiment. verification includes the original failure and at least two nearby cases.

documents.title: Design an Expense Index
documents.text: design an expense index implement an expense collection that preserves display order rejects duplicate ids supports typical constant time lookup by id and documents the complexity of each public operation. display order remains deterministic. duplicate identifiers produce an explicit failure. complexity claims name average or worst case assumptions.

documents.title: Model an Expense API Boundary
documents.text: model an expense api boundary design request dto domain and result types for loading expenses including status handling and validation for missing ids and negative amounts. http outcomes remain distinct from domain values. external json cannot create an invalid expense. retry guidance distinguishes idempotent reads from unsafe duplicate creation.

documents.title: Build the Level 1 Expense Manager
documents.text: build the level 1 expense manager build the complete kotlin command line expense manager described in this lesson including validated domain models repository boundary explicit results totals tests documentation and focused git history. all must have acceptance examples pass. the domain has no console json or filesystem dependency. tests cover valid empty duplicate and invalid cases. a readme explains running testing design decisions and optional extensions.

documents.title: Create a Toolchain Evidence Report
documents.text: create a toolchain evidence report create a reproducible environment report for one emulator and demonstrate separate build connection installation and launch checks. every relevant tool and platform version is recorded. the emulator configuration includes api level and system image type. each command is labelled with the boundary it verifies.

documents.title: Map a Multi-Module Notes Project
documents.text: map a multi module notes project design a three module notes project and document module outputs source set locations and every allowed dependency edge. the dependency graph is acyclic. local and device tests are placed in correct source sets. each module boundary has a stated ownership reason.

documents.title: Trace an Android Build
documents.text: trace an android build run one debug assembly and produce an annotated trace of wrapper version requested task prerequisite task categories dependency classpath output artifact and one simulated failure. the wrapper and agp roles are distinguished. the artifact path and selected variant are exact. the failure analysis identifies the first actionable task diagnostic.

documents.title: Audit a Merged Manifest
documents.text: audit a merged manifest create a manifest and resources audit for a notes app with one launcher activity a debug application id suffix default strings and one locale alternative. every exported component has a documented reason. namespace and both variant application ids are recorded. all alternative string resources have defaults with compatible formatting arguments.

documents.title: Design a Compatibility and Release Matrix
documents.text: design a compatibility and release matrix define a notes app sdk policy debug release variants emulator test matrix artifact commands and guarded use of one api newer than minsdk. each sdk setting has a separate evidence based rationale. both old and new runtime api paths are tested. debug apk and release aab outputs and signing responsibilities are documented.

documents.title: Remove a Context Leak
documents.text: remove a context leak refactor a notes singleton that retains mainactivity into scoped dependencies and demonstrate restoration after process recreation. no long lived object retains an activity. durable notes reconstruct from storage rather than memory globals. a cold deep link entry works without launcher first setup.

documents.title: Build a Lifecycle Trace Screen
documents.text: build a lifecycle trace screen create an activity that records transitions and owns a visible only observer through a lifecycle aware api then test launch background overlay rotation and return. the trace distinguishes instance identity across recreation. the observer runs only while the screen is visible. no durable save depends solely on ondestroy.

documents.title: Make a Draft Survive Recreation
documents.text: make a draft survive recreation create a notes screen state holder that preserves query and selection across rotation without retaining ui objects then document what still disappears after process death. rotation creates a new activity while keeping expected screen data. the viewmodel contains no context view activity or fragment. the report distinguishes recreation from process death restoration.

documents.title: Build and Test Note Restoration
documents.text: build and test note restoration implement selected note and query restoration using savedstatehandle plus a persistent repository then test rotation stopped process recreation back and fresh launch. only small reconstruction values enter saved state. full notes reload from durable storage. expected behaviour is documented separately for all four scenarios.

documents.title: Internationalise the Notes Summary
documents.text: internationalise the notes summary create default and second locale resources for titles formatted dates and note counts plus night colours and a test checklist for rtl pseudo locale and large font scale. every alternative has a valid default. quantities and formatted messages remain complete translation units. stable note categories are stored independently of translated labels.

documents.title: Add Safe Note Import and Sharing
documents.text: add safe note import and sharing implement text sharing and document import with an explicit contract cancellation handling uri validation and recreation safe launcher registration. no handler and cancelled outcomes are safe. the launcher is registered unconditionally. incoming content is validated before it becomes a note.

documents.title: Design an Optional Voice-Note Permission Flow
documents.text: design an optional voice note permission flow design and implement a microphone feature that requests only on user action supports denial and revocation and leaves text notes fully usable. every permission state has visible product behaviour. a denial never loops or blocks note editing. tests cover revocation while the app is backgrounded.

documents.title: Write a Background-Work Decision Record
documents.text: write a background work decision record classify audio note playback local backup a short boot event and cross app note query into appropriate components or apis with lifecycle and failure reasoning. every choice names urgency visibility duration and retry needs. no service is assumed to provide a worker thread. foreground service choices include notification and stop behaviour.

documents.title: Build a Secure Note Notification Action
documents.text: build a secure note notification action create a notification action that opens one note with an immutable pendingintent and document request identity deep link validation and cold process behaviour. each note action resolves to the correct stable id. the pendingintent is explicit and immutable. opening works when no application process exists.

documents.title: Implement a Cold-Safe Note App Link
documents.text: implement a cold safe note app link define a verified https note id app link and a navigation policy for cold process warm task logged out user missing note malformed id back and up. the filter and asset association are narrow and documented. all uri and access states have explicit outcomes. only a stable id enters navigation and full data reloads from storage.

documents.title: Build an Adaptive XML Note Editor
documents.text: build an adaptive xml note editor create an accessible xml editor that adapts to long text rtl large fonts portrait landscape and a narrow multi window size. the hierarchy has a reason for every container. all controls expose labels and usable touch focus behaviour. no user visible string or dimension is hard coded in kotlin.

documents.title: Refactor a Leaking Fragment Layout
documents.text: refactor a leaking fragment layout convert a nested note editor to constraintlayout and view binding then prove the binding is unavailable after ondestroyview. both axes are fully constrained at narrow and wide sizes. no findviewbyid or unsafe global view reference remains. view lifecycle collection and binding cleanup are demonstrated.

documents.title: Build a Restorable Two-Fragment Flow
documents.text: build a restorable two fragment flow create list and note editor fragments with navigation view lifecycle safe binding id only arguments and correct restoration after rotation and process recreation. no view reference survives ondestroyview. back and deep link routes reconstruct from note id. fragmentmanager restoration produces no duplicate fragments.

documents.title: Build a Correct Notes List
documents.text: build a correct notes list implement a listadapter notes screen with view binding immutable rows stable id diffing pinned state clicks empty state and rapid update tests. recycled rows never show stale pinned or selected state. clicks always report the current stable note id. diff callbacks distinguish identity from content correctly.

documents.title: Embed a Legacy Editor in Compose
documents.text: embed a legacy editor in compose host an xml note editor inside a compose screen with androidviewbinding one viewmodel state source correct listeners dark rtl rotation tests and no feedback loop. factory inflation and update responsibilities are separate. both toolkits render one shared immutable state. lifecycle and restoration behaviour are verified.

documents.title: Build the Level 2 Personal Notes App
documents.text: build the level 2 personal notes app build the complete local first notes app with multiple screens configuration and process restoration a verified note app link one contextual runtime permission and an xml screen hosted inside compose. required acceptance scenarios pass on minimum and recent apis. only stable ids and small ui values enter navigation saved state. manifest exposure permission degradation back and cold entry are documented. the xml and compose surfaces share one state event model.

documents.title: Create a State Gallery
documents.text: create a state gallery build previews and a runtime screen for loading empty populated long title and error note states using one stateless content composable. every visual state is supplied through parameters. no preview or composable body mutates a repository. runtime events are callbacks and remain testable.

documents.title: Build a Modifier Order Lab
documents.text: build a modifier order lab create paired examples showing padding background clip clickable size requiredsize and offset differences including semantic bounds. each pair explains the wrapper order. touch and accessibility bounds are inspected. the reusable sample accepts caller modifier correctly.

documents.title: Build a Responsive Note Row and Pane
documents.text: build a responsive note row and pane create a note row that survives long text and a compact expanded list detail layout sharing one selection state. row actions retain accessible touch size. large fonts and rtl remain usable. changing available width does not reset selection.

documents.title: Build a Notes Scaffold and Slot Card
documents.text: build a notes scaffold and slot card create a notes screen shell with app bar snackbar fab correctly padded list and a reusable note card with leading and action slots. content never hides under chrome. actions use semantic material components. the card api avoids boolean configuration combinations.

documents.title: Build a Localised Note Form
documents.text: build a localised note form create title body inputs with saved state validation keyboard actions plural character feedback and correct icon image semantics. fields remain controlled across recreation. all application text comes from resources and handles large fonts. validation does not rely on keyboard type.

documents.title: Build a State Lifetime Lab
documents.text: build a state lifetime lab create transient expansion a restorable draft viewmodel screen state and a persisted note then document what survives each recreation event. each value has one named owner and lifetime. saved state contains no large payload. tests distinguish recomposition rotation and reload.

documents.title: Refactor Search to UDF
documents.text: refactor search to udf split a coupled search feature into a route stateless content immutable uistate and explicit query retry and selection events. only one query source of truth remains. leaf content has no viewmodel dependency. previews can supply every screen state.

documents.title: Repair a Reordering Editor
documents.text: repair a reordering editor build a reorderable note editor with per row draft state and a jump to top threshold demonstrating stable keys and narrow observation. drafts follow note ids after sorting. threshold state avoids per pixel composition changes. inspection explains the scopes that update.

documents.title: Build a Sectioned Paged Catalogue
documents.text: build a sectioned paged catalogue create keyed catalogue content with sticky filters multiple content types restored position and explicit loading retry and end states. rows preserve state after sorting. only one guarded next page request runs. empty and error states remain accessible.

documents.title: Build a Typed Notes Graph
documents.text: build a typed notes graph create typed list detail and edit routes with an external deep link minimal arguments missing note handling and decoupled callbacks. no route serialises a domain object. back up and deep link behaviour are specified. graph and screen callbacks are tested independently.

documents.title: Audit a Screen Effect Map
documents.text: audit a screen effect map refactor a profile screen so refresh analytics formatting navigation and a listener each use the correct state event or effect boundary. no external work runs in a composable body. each effect documents restart and cleanup. pure calculations remain pure and testable.

documents.title: Build a Cancellable Search Experience
documents.text: build a cancellable search experience create a route that changes query identity scrolls on result replacement and shows event driven retry snackbars without duplicate or stale work. key changes cancel outdated ui work. snackbar launches only from an event. business search remains owned by the viewmodel.

documents.title: Bridge a Lifecycle Observer Safely
documents.text: bridge a lifecycle observer safely integrate a lifecycle observer and analytics property publisher while proving one registration balanced cleanup and latest callback behaviour. observer count returns to zero on disposal. analytics receives only committed state. callback changes do not restart the observer resource.

documents.title: Build Scroll Threshold Signals
documents.text: build scroll threshold signals implement a jump to top control and one analytics transition using derivedstateof and snapshotflow without recording every scroll update. ui threshold changes only at the boundary. analytics records one transition per crossing. collection cancels with the list state owner.

documents.title: Build a Lifecycle-aware Notes Route
documents.text: build a lifecycle aware notes route create repository flow viewmodel stateflow a lifecycle aware route and stateless content with explicit loading empty error and content states. upstream data has one immutable screen contract. inactive destination collection follows lifecycle policy. content previews cover every state without a viewmodel.

documents.title: Profile and Repair a Slow Feed
documents.text: profile and repair a slow feed create a reproducibly slow compose feed capture release mode evidence apply one stability or state read fix and record the before and after result. the scenario and device conditions are documented. the fix targets evidence rather than a guess. correctness tests pass before and after.

documents.title: Build a Semantic Chip Flow
documents.text: build a semantic chip flow create a one pass wrapping chip layout that obeys compact constraints mirrors placement in rtl and preserves logical semantics and touch targets. every child is measured once. reported size obeys constraints. rtl and accessibility traversal are verified.

documents.title: Build an Accessible Progress Chart
documents.text: build an accessible progress chart create a cached progress or weekly xp chart with testable geometry zero and maximum states responsive sizing and an equivalent semantic summary. geometry logic is tested separately. expensive paths are reused appropriately. semantics convey the same key result as pixels.

documents.title: Build an Accessible Reorder Handle
documents.text: build an accessible reorder handle create a drag reorder handle with cancellation stable item identity haptic or visual feedback and equivalent keyboard and accessibility actions. drag state resets on cancellation. rows retain stable ids after movement. non touch users can move items.

documents.title: Build a Collapsing Animated Header
documents.text: build a collapsing animated header create an interruptible animated header that consumes nested scroll only within its collapse range and remains correct under rapid direction changes. child scrolling receives unconsumed deltas. animation reaches current logical state after interruption. reduced motion behaviour remains usable.

documents.title: Build a Quest Design System Slice
documents.text: build a quest design system slice create light and dark semantic tokens plus two accessible slot based components documenting why each dependency is explicit or tree scoped. tokens express roles rather than screen specific colours. components retain semantic material behaviour. previews cover long text rtl and large font.

documents.title: Audit a Shopping Journey with TalkBack
documents.text: audit a shopping journey with talkback make product browsing variant selection adding to basket error recovery and checkout summary operable and understandable through semantics and talkback. every control has meaningful role state and action. focus order and announcements support the full task. automated checks and a manual talkback script both pass.

documents.title: Build a Keyboard and Large-text Product Form
documents.text: build a keyboard and large text product form create a product search and purchase form that completes with keyboard or d pad and remains usable at large font and display scale. traversal reaches controls in a logical order. no important label clips at tested scales. touch keyboard and accessibility activation produce the same events.

documents.title: Internationalise the Shopping Shell
documents.text: internationalise the shopping shell localise basket prices dates errors and navigation verify pseudo locales one rtl locale light dark schemes and dynamic colour fallback. no app sentence is assembled from translated fragments. directional controls and focus behave correctly in rtl. theme roles pass contrast checks in representative states.

documents.title: Harden an Edge-to-edge Checkout
documents.text: harden an edge to edge checkout build a scrolling checkout with app bar fixed action focused fields and animated keyboard behaviour across gesture and three button navigation. no inset is applied twice. focused fields and actions remain reachable with ime open. system bar icons retain contrast over all backgrounds.

documents.title: Build an Adaptive Shopping Catalogue
documents.text: build an adaptive shopping catalogue create compact and expanded product navigation with list detail panes retained selection predictive back expectations and a documented navigation compose versus navigation 3 boundary. selection and scroll state survive live resize. compact and expanded back behaviour is tested. feature content has no dependency on a navigation controller.

documents.title: Deliver the Adaptive Shopping Capstone
documents.text: deliver the adaptive shopping capstone build the level 3 shopping vertical slice with local data adaptive catalogue and detail basket flow animation themes accessibility edge to edge and layered test evidence. browse to basket works in compact and expanded windows. talkback keyboard large text rtl and dark theme checks are documented. unit semantic ui accessibility and screenshot tests protect distinct contracts.

documents.title: Make a Legacy Data Source Main-safe
documents.text: make a legacy data source main safe wrap blocking file and cpu heavy parsing operations behind one main safe suspend api with injected dispatchers and deterministic tests. main callers never execute blocking i o. context switches occur only around owned work. tests use replaceable dispatchers on one scheduler.

documents.title: Build a Structured Dashboard Loader
documents.text: build a structured dashboard loader load two independent dashboard sources concurrently one dependent source sequentially and prove completion cancellation and failure through the job tree. only independent operations overlap. caller cancellation stops every child. no coroutine uses an ownerless global scope.

documents.title: Cancel an Obsolete Import Safely
documents.text: cancel an obsolete import safely implement a cancellable article import with cpu parsing a closable input resource an operation timeout and tests proving no stale publication. cpu work checks cancellation. resources close on success failure and cancellation. timeout and user cancellation have distinct outcomes.

documents.title: Design a Partially Available Dashboard
documents.text: design a partially available dashboard load three independent panels under supervision one required identity call without supervision and map each failure to a tested screen outcome. required failure cancels the operation. optional panel failure leaves useful siblings available. every deferred result or failure is observed.

documents.title: Build a Single-flight Article Cache
documents.text: build a single flight article cache create a cache that deduplicates concurrent loads per article id publishes immutable state and remains correct under cancellation and failure. concurrent callers share one in flight load per id. failure removes stale in flight state. stress tests preserve every cache invariant.

documents.title: Test Retry, Timeout, and Cancellation
documents.text: test retry timeout and cancellation write deterministic tests for a repository with loading state exponential retry delays operation timeout child cancellation and dispatcher switching. every testdispatcher shares one scheduler. intermediate states are asserted before completion. cancelled work never publishes a late result.

documents.title: Build and Trace a Cold Article Stream
documents.text: build and trace a cold article stream create a cold article flow with injected upstream dispatcher transformation cancellation failure handling and tests for two independent collectors. repeated collection behaviour is demonstrated. no flow builder emits from an invalid context. cancellation and upstream failure remain distinct.

documents.title: Build a Typed Refresh Pipeline
documents.text: build a typed refresh pipeline create a flow that maps external models emits loading retries transient i o with virtual time backoff uses cache fallback and preserves cancellation. retry policy has explicit classification and limit. mapping and collector failures are tested separately. exhaustion exposes a typed user outcome.

documents.title: Build a Replaceable Search Pipeline
documents.text: build a replaceable search pipeline combine query and filters debounce input replace obsolete searches and test rapid changes cancellation initial state and errors. latest accepted request owns visible results. old source collection is demonstrably cancelled. durable selection events use a non cancelling path.

documents.title: Design Three Pressure Policies
documents.text: design three pressure policies implement and test separate pipelines for progress state audit events and cancellable previews with explicit capacity loss and latency rules. no required event is silently discarded. state like updates favour current value. tests prove exact slow collector behaviour.

documents.title: Model State and Signals Explicitly
documents.text: model state and signals explicitly design a news screen with durable uistate a best effort scroll signal and an acknowledged critical result then test recreation and multiple collectors. every stream documents replay and loss. critical outcomes survive absent collectors. external code cannot mutate owner state.

documents.title: Share a Repository Stream Correctly
documents.text: share a repository stream correctly expose repository updates as viewmodel stateflow with a justified start timeout lifecycle aware ui collection and tests for start stop replay and upstream failure. only one upstream collection serves multiple subscribers. collection stops under documented policy. tests use an active collector and one scheduler.

documents.title: Specify a News API Contract
documents.text: specify a news api contract write and test the http contract for article listing conditional refresh article lookup bookmarking conflict rate limit and typed error responses. every method and status has explicit body semantics. cache validators and sensitive header policy are defined. retry safety is documented per operation.

documents.title: Harden Article JSON Mapping
documents.text: harden article json mapping create dto domain mapper reviewed json configuration and fixture tests for missing unknown malformed null and forward compatible article data. domain models never contain invalid identity or time. compatibility options are documented individually. fixtures contain no sensitive production data.

documents.title: Build a Swappable News Remote Source
documents.text: build a swappable news remote source declare a retrofit article api implement status and dto mapping in a remote source wrap it in a repository and verify requests through mockwebserver. no retrofit or dto type reaches ui state. client instances are shared and injected. integration tests cover success empty error malformed and cancellation.

documents.title: Build a Redacted Network Client
documents.text: build a redacted network client configure one okhttp client with correlation authentication header cache policy safe logging and tests that assert chain order and secret redaction. interceptors proceed correctly and preserve requests. no credential or body appears in captured logs. client resources are shared across api calls.

documents.title: Implement a Typed Retry Engine
documents.text: implement a typed retry engine build a cancellable retry engine with typed transport and http failures timeout budget exponential backoff and jitter retry after support and idempotency gating. permanent and authentication failures do not loop. cancellation stops active call or delay. virtual time tests prove attempts delays and exhaustion.

documents.title: Build a Hermetic News Client Suite
documents.text: build a hermetic news client suite test the week 16 news client end to end through mockwebserver for success conditional request empty body typed errors malformed json timeout retry cancellation and log redaction. no test reaches the public internet. recorded requests verify path query and safe headers. adverse responses map to exact typed outcomes.

documents.title: Design a Secure Session Repository
documents.text: design a secure session repository specify a pkce sign in session model credential persistence boundary account switch expiry redacted diagnostics and complete logout path. no static secret is bundled in the app. raw tokens never leave the session boundary or logs. logout produces one tested unauthenticated state and cache policy.

documents.title: Implement a Concurrent-safe Authenticator
documents.text: implement a concurrent safe authenticator build a session refresh coordinator and okhttp authentication path that handles expiry concurrent 401s rotation one replay cancellation and terminal logout. concurrent challenges cause exactly one refresh. refresh cannot recursively authenticate itself. terminal failure logs out once and releases all waiters.

documents.title: Build a Cursor-paged News Feed
documents.text: build a cursor paged news feed implement and test a cursor pagingsource with stable ids filter invalidation refresh keys append retry empty state and viewmodel caching. opaque cursors are never interpreted. refresh and append failures render separately. tests cover terminal retry and invalidation cases.

documents.title: Build a Durable Attachment Upload
documents.text: build a durable attachment upload stream a picked image with metadata sampled progress cancellation persistent uri access stable idempotency id and recoverable background scheduling. memory use is independent of file size. cancellation closes every resource. retry reconciles to one remote attachment.

documents.title: Build a Resumable Live Headlines Stream
documents.text: build a resumable live headlines stream implement a callbackflow backed sse or websocket client with states authentication bounded buffering heartbeat resume ids deduplication snapshot recovery and cancellation. owner cancellation releases the connection. reconnect uses capped jitter and stops on permanent failure. duplicate and missing sequence cases reconcile correctly.

documents.title: Build Connectivity-aware News Policy
documents.text: build connectivity aware news policy expose validated and metered hints keep local reading available coalesce restoration sync defer large media and test handover and false positive connectivity. no capability is treated as guaranteed api reachability. callbacks are registered and removed with one owner. repeated restoration creates only one sync request.

documents.title: Model the News Database
documents.text: model the news database design article author bookmark remote key and pending mutation entities with daos indices relationships atomic page replacement and rollback tests. stable keys and uniqueness protect identity. no network call runs inside a transaction. relationship and rollback behaviour is tested on room.

documents.title: Evolve and Search the News Schema
documents.text: evolve and search the news schema add summaries authors indices and fts across two schema versions with exported schemas and tests from every supported version containing real bookmarks and queued writes. all user owned rows survive upgrade. fts results handle documented language cases. no unsupported path silently deletes data.

documents.title: Build Settings and Export Storage
documents.text: build settings and export storage implement typed sync settings corruption handling one time migration cached thumbnails and atomic user selected article export with tested interruption. one datastore instance owns its file. cache and durable file lifetimes are distinct. interrupted export never replaces a valid file with partial data.

documents.title: Build a Local-first Feed Repository
documents.text: build a local first feed repository expose room only feed reads with etag and ttl metadata deduplicated refresh 304 handling stale content cache eviction and preserved bookmarks. presentation has one source of truth. older refresh cannot overwrite newer state. stale and failed refresh states retain usable local content.

documents.title: Build an Offline Bookmark Outbox
documents.text: build an offline bookmark outbox implement optimistic bookmark state durable outbox idempotent sync coalescing authentication pause conflict versions rejection recovery and two device convergence tests. process death never loses accepted intent. duplicate delivery has one logical effect. every conflict and permanent rejection has a visible resolution.

documents.title: Schedule a Reliable Sync Engine
documents.text: schedule a reliable sync engine connect an idempotent outbox drain to unique workmanager work with constraints bounded retry cancellation progress checkpoints logout handling and workmanager tests. repeated triggers create one active chain. process interruption repeats no logical mutation. transient and permanent outcomes schedule differently.

documents.title: Deliver the Offline-First News Reader
documents.text: deliver the offline first news reader build the full level 4 news slice with room source of truth cursor paging etag refresh datastore settings secure session refresh bookmark outbox workmanager sync conflicts migrations and layered tests. previously synchronized articles and bookmarks work offline. process death and duplicate delivery lose no accepted intent. paging authentication migrations retries and eventual convergence have deterministic evidence.

documents.title: Apply Layers, Boundaries, and Dependency Direction
documents.text: apply layers boundaries and dependency direction draw the dependency map for a banking accounts feature assign every state mutation and error translation to one owner and remove any boundary that has no testable purpose. every important state and dependency has one named owner. dependencies point through the smallest consumer facing contracts. tests graph checks or measurements cover the primary failure and change scenarios.

documents.title: Apply Immutable UI State and Unidirectional Data Flow
documents.text: apply immutable ui state and unidirectional data flow model a transfer form as immutable state enumerate events and legal transitions then test invalid input submission duplicate taps failure and successful recreation. every important state and dependency has one named owner. dependencies point through the smallest consumer facing contracts. tests graph checks or measurements cover the primary failure and change scenarios.

documents.title: Apply State Holders, Events, and UI Logic
documents.text: apply state holders events and ui logic audit the events in a login and payment flow assign ui behaviour and business logic to appropriate owners and prove that critical outcomes survive collector absence. every important state and dependency has one named owner. dependencies point through the smallest consumer facing contracts. tests graph checks or measurements cover the primary failure and change scenarios.

documents.title: Apply Repositories, Sources of Truth, and Mappers
documents.text: apply repositories sources of truth and mappers design an accounts repository contract map api and room models to an external account model and write contract tests for stale reads refresh malformed data and transfer failure. every important state and dependency has one named owner. dependencies point through the smallest consumer facing contracts. tests graph checks or measurements cover the primary failure and change scenarios.

documents.title: Apply Use Cases, Business Rules, and Error Models

easier to place. realworlduse android applications are larger programs but the same path remains source code is checked translated run and observed through output or ui behaviour. outcome read run and explain a small kotlin program from its entry point to its output. learn estimatedminutes 8 sections id source code and behaviour title source code becomes behaviour blocks type paragraph text a program is an ordered set of instructions written in a programming language. kotlin source files normally end in .kt. you write human readable declarations and expressions kotlin tooling checks that they follow the language rules and translates them into instructions a runtime can execute. a syntax error means the text is not valid kotlin. a logic error means the program runs but does the wrong thing. learning to separate those two failure classes will save time throughout the course. type flow title from source file to result steps id write label write detail create or edit kotlin source entry point. id observe label observe detail output reveals what the program did. type callout tone remember title compiler as guide text a compiler error is precise evidence that a rule was broken. read the first error before changing code at random. id entry point title the entry point and function body blocks type paragraph text a standalone kotlin program begins in a function named main. the fun keyword declares a function main is its name parentheses hold its parameters and braces contain its body. execution proceeds through the body from top to bottom unless another construct changes the flow. blank lines and indentation help people read the program braces and other syntax tell the compiler how it is structured. type code language kotlin code fun main n println welcome to droidquest n println week 1 begins n caption execution enters main and performs each println call in order. type paragraph text the code calls println twice. calling a function means asking a named piece of behaviour to run. each call receives text between parentheses. kotlin string literals use double quotes. println writes its value and then starts a new line so the two messages appear on separate lines. a statement performs an action an expression produces a value. kotlin uses expressions extensively and later lessons will combine produced values into decisions and calculations. id documents.text: values variables types and strings scout purpose programs become useful when they can name and transform information instead of printing fixed text. realworlduse android code stores user names item counts prices feature states identifiers and screen text in deliberately typed values. outcome declare clear kotlin values choose basic types and build readable text with string templates. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id names for values title names for values blocks type paragraph text a variable associates a meaningful name with a value. kotlin uses val for a read only reference and var for a reference that may be reassigned. prefer val until the program genuinely needs reassignment fewer changing values means fewer possible states to reason about. read val learnername mina as learnername refers to this string and the reference will not be assigned again. read var completedlessons 0 as this int may receive a later value. type code language kotlin code val learnername mina nvar completedlessons 0 ncompletedlessons completedlessons + 1 n nprintln learnername nprintln completedlessons caption the name stays fixed while the completed lesson count deliberately changes. type paragraph text reassignment changes which value a variable holds it does not redeclare the variable. writing val twice with the same name in one scope is an error. good names describe the information not its type or its position. completedlessons communicates more than number or x. kotlin convention uses lower camel case for local variables the first word begins lowercase and each later word begins uppercase. id types and inference title types describe permitted values blocks type paragraph text every kotlin value has a type. a type defines which values are possible and which operations are valid. common starting types are int for whole numbers double for decimal numbers boolean for true or false char for one character and string for text. kotlin often infers the type from the assigned value. the compiler reads val stars 3 and infers int. an explicit annotation val stars int 3 states the same fact and is useful when inference would hide important intent. type table title basic kotlin types columns type example typical use rows int 42 counts and whole number quantities double 19.95 decimal measurements or prices boolean true yes or no fractional values while integer division discards a remainder. money also needs careful modelling because binary floating point is not exact for every decimal later production lessons will introduce
