documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs types overview.html whyread use this as the official reference for kotlin numbers booleans characters strings arrays and special types. title strings publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs strings.html whyread expands on string templates multiline text common operations and safe conversion from text into other types. inspect title build an expense summary language kotlin code fun main n val category string travel n val journeys 3 n val fare 2.75 n val total journeys fare n val approved total 10.0 n n println category category n println total total n println within limit approved n walkthrough the explicit string annotation documents the category type the remaining types are inferred. multiplying int by double produces the decimal total used by the next comparison. each template presents a named result instead of embedding unexplained calculations in output. expectedoutput category travel ntotal 8.25 nwithin limit true trap check mistake using var for every declaration by habit. why unnecessary reassignment increases the number of states the reader must consider. fix start with val and change to var only when reassignment is required. mistake putting a decimal value into an inferred int variable. why a variable keeps its inferred type 2 and 2.5 are values of different numeric types. fix choose double initially when fractional values are valid. challenge intro task model one expense using named values calculate its total and print a readable two line summary. successlookslike names reveal intent val is used by default numeric types fit the data and string templates present the calculated result. recall prompt when should you prefer val over var answer prefer val whenever the reference does not need to be reassigned. prompt what does type inference do answer it lets the compiler determine a declaration type from its assigned value. prompt when does a string template need braces answer use braces around an expression or when its boundary would otherwise be unclear. kotlin variables types strings

documents.title: Expressions, Booleans, and Decisions
documents.text: expressions booleans and decisions scout purpose programs need to calculate facts and select behaviour from those facts instead of following one fixed path. realworlduse android applications decide whether buttons are enabled which screen state to show and whether input is valid using boolean expressions and branches. outcome build boolean conditions and use if and when expressions to produce deliberate results. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id expressions produce values title expressions produce values blocks type paragraph text an expression is code that evaluates to a value. the literal 5 the calculation quantity price and the comparison total budget are all expressions. operators combine values arithmetic operators calculate numbers comparison operators produce boolean results and logical operators combine boolean results. parentheses make grouping explicit and should be used when the intended order is not immediately obvious. type table title operator groups columns purpose operators result rows arithmetic + a numeric value comparison a boolean value logical a boolean value grouping expression the grouped expression result type paragraph text use to ask whether values are equal. a single assigns a value and has a different purpose. the remainder operator is useful for recurring patterns such as even number checks. integer division uses integer rules 5 2 evaluates to 2 not 2.5. if a fractional result matters at least one operand must have a suitable decimal type. id boolean questions title write conditions as questions blocks type paragraph text a boolean is either true or false. useful boolean names often read like questions isvalid hasbudget or cansubmit. logical and written requires both sides to be true. logical or written requires at least one side. logical not written reverses a boolean. these operators short circuit skips its right side when the left is false while skips its right side when the left is true. type code language kotlin code val amount 24.0 nval hasdescription true nval withinlimit amount 50.0 nval cansave amount 0.0 hasdescription withinlimit n nprintln can save cansave caption each named boolean explains one part of the final save decision. type callout tone remember title name intermediate facts text several small named boolean expressions are usually easier to inspect than one long condition containing every rule. id if and when title choose a result with if or when blocks type paragraph text kotlin if is an expression so it can directly produce a value. both branches must produce compatible results when assigned. use if for a two way choice or a small condition. use when when one subject or rule set has several meaningful outcomes. a when used as a value must cover every possible case commonly with an else branch until the alternatives are represented by a closed type. type code language kotlin code val amount 72.0 nval label if amount 50.0 within budget else review required n nval band when n amount 0.0 invalid n amount 25.0 small n amount 100.0 standard n else large n n nprintln label band caption if produces a two way label when checks ordered rules and uses the first matching branch. type flow title decision evaluation steps id facts label calculate facts detail produce boolean values from the current data. id select label select branch detail evaluate conditions in their written order. id result label produce result detail the chosen branch returns its value. id continue label continue detail later code uses the selected value. type paragraph text branch order matters when conditions overlap. in the amount band example a negative number also satisfies amount 25.0 so the invalid case must appear first. conditions should partition the domain intentionally. when rules become difficult to describe in one sentence extract them into named values or functions rather than adding deeper nesting. furtherreading title conditions and loops publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs control flow.html whyread the official reference for if and when expressions branch forms conditions and kotlin control flow behaviour. title booleans publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs booleans.html whyread deepens the lesson with truth values comparison results logical operations precedence and short circuit evaluation. inspect title classify a purchase language kotlin code fun main n val amount 48.0 n val category travel n val needsreceipt amount 25.0 n val cansubmit amount 0.0 category.isnotblank n n val status when n cansubmit blocked n needsreceipt receipt required n else ready n n n println status n walkthrough two named booleans capture independent business facts about the purchase. when tests the blocking rule before the receipt rule so invalid data cannot be marked ready. the amount and non blank category make cansubmit true the amount also requires a receipt. expectedoutput receipt required trap check mistake using when you intend to compare two values. why assignment and equality are different operations kotlin equality uses two equals signs. fix use or for equality questions. mistake placing a broad when condition before a narrower case. why the first matching branch wins so later special cases may never run. fix order exceptional and narrow rules before broader rules. challenge intro task create an expense approval decision using amount category and receipt information. successlookslike named boolean facts make the rules readable invalid input is handled first and if or when produces one clear status. recall prompt what value does a comparison expression produce answer a comparison expression produces a boolean value. prompt why does when branch order matter answer evaluation stops at the first matching branch. prompt what is short circuit evaluation answer a logical operator skips an unnecessary right hand expression once its result is known. kotlin expressions booleans conditions

documents.title: Repeating Work with Loops and Ranges
documents.text: repeating work with loops and ranges scout purpose a program should express repeated work once and apply it safely to many values. realworlduse android code iterates over screen items validation errors database results retry attempts and batches of work. outcome choose a for or while loop define its boundary and trace changing loop state. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id for and ranges title use for when the values are known blocks type paragraph text a for loop visits each value supplied by an iterable source. ranges are a convenient source for ordered numbers. the closed range 1..5 includes both endpoints. the open ended range 0.. size excludes size and is useful for valid zero based indexes. downto counts downward and step changes the interval. prefer iterating directly over collection values when you do not need indexes it communicates intent and avoids boundary mistakes. type code language kotlin code for day in 1..3 n println day day n n nfor index in 0.. 3 n println index index n caption the first range includes 3 the second stops before 3. type table title range forms columns form values use rows 1..3 1 2 3 closed range including both ends 0.. 3 0 1 2 open upper bound 3 downto 1 3 2 1 descending sequence 0..6 step 2 0 2 4 6 regular interval id while and progress title use while when repetition depends on a condition blocks type paragraph text a while loop repeats while its condition remains true. it fits work where the number of iterations is not known in advance such as reading valid input or retrying until a limit. the body must make progress toward making the condition false. if it does not the loop may never end. identify the initial state continuation condition and state update before writing the body. type flow title a safe while loop steps id initialise label initialise detail create the state used by the condition. id check label check detail stop immediately when the condition is false. id work label work detail perform one iteration of useful behaviour. id update label update detail move state toward termination. id repeat label repeat detail return to the condition with new state. type code language kotlin code var attempts 0 nval maximumattempts 3 n nwhile attempts maximumattempts n attempts + 1 n println attempt attempts n caption attempts changes every iteration so the condition eventually becomes false. id accumulators and tracing title build a result across iterations blocks type paragraph text an accumulator stores a result built across iterations. a total often starts at zero and adds each value. a product starts at one. a text result may begin empty. because an accumulator changes it is commonly a var even when surrounding data remains val. keep the mutable state close to the loop and make the update easy to spot. later collection operators will express many common loops without manual mutation but understanding the mechanics remains essential for debugging and performance reasoning. type code language kotlin code val dailyexpenses listof 4.50 8.25 3.00 nvar total 0.0 n nfor expense in dailyexpenses n total + expense n println added expense total is total n n nprintln final total total caption tracing after each update shows exactly how the accumulator reaches its final value. type paragraph text before running a loop trace a small example in a table with columns for iteration current item state before and state after. this exposes off by one errors and updates placed in the wrong location. avoid changing the collection you are iterating unless the api explicitly supports it. if a loop contains several unrelated responsibilities move one responsibility into a function so the iteration remains readable. furtherreading title conditions and loops publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs control flow.html whyread reinforces for while do while break and continue using the complete official language reference. title ranges and progressions publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs ranges.html whyread explains closed and open ranges downward progressions steps and the boundary behaviour behind kotlin loops. inspect title sum approved expenses only language kotlin code fun main n val expenses listof 12.0 3.0 8.5 0.0 n var total 0.0 n n for amount in expenses n if amount 0.0 n total + amount n n n n println approved total total n walkthrough the for loop visits every amount directly so no index is required. the condition rejects zero and negative values before they reach the accumulator. only 12.0 and 8.5 are added leaving a final total of 20.5. expectedoutput approved total 20.5 trap check mistake using 0..items.size to access list indexes. why the closed range includes items.size which is one position beyond the final valid index. fix iterate over items directly use items.indices or use 0.. items.size. mistake forgetting to update state inside a while loop. why the continuation condition may remain true forever and create an infinite loop. fix write the intended progress update before filling in other loop work. challenge intro task process a list of seven daily amounts ignore invalid values and calculate both the total and valid item count. successlookslike the loop has correct boundaries mutable accumulators are minimal and a trace explains the first three iterations. recall prompt when is a for loop the clearer choice answer use for when iterating over a known range or collection of values. prompt what three facts define a while loop answer its initial state continuation condition and progress update. prompt why does 0..size often cause a bug answer the closed range includes size which is beyond the last zero based index. kotlin loops ranges iteration

documents.title: Functions as Reusable Decisions
documents.text: functions as reusable decisions scout purpose functions turn a growing program into named reusable decisions with clear inputs and outputs. realworlduse android projects use functions for validation state updates formatting mapping data event handling and nearly every interaction with a library. outcome declare call and decompose functions using parameters return types defaults and named arguments. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id function contract title a function is a contract blocks type paragraph text a function has a name zero or more parameters a return type and a body. parameters describe the inputs available to the body. a return value communicates the result to the caller. read fun calculatetotal quantity int price double double as a contract provide an int and a double and receive a double. kotlin function parameters are read only inside the body which prevents the function from quietly replacing the caller s input names. type code language kotlin code fun calculatetotal quantity int price double double n return quantity price n n nfun main n val total calculatetotal quantity 3 price 2.50 n println total n caption the caller supplies two arguments and stores the returned calculation. type table title function vocabulary columns term meaning rows declaration defines a function and its contract parameter named input in the declaration argument value supplied by a caller return type type promised to the caller return value specific result produced by one call id expression bodies and unit title return a value or perform an action blocks type paragraph text a short function that returns one expression can use an expression body fun isvalid amount double amount 0.0. the compiler infers the return type although explicit return types are valuable for public apis because they preserve the intended contract. a function that only performs an action returns unit. unit means the call completes without producing a meaningful domain result it is not the same as failure or absence. type code language kotlin code fun isvalidamount amount double boolean amount 0.0 n nfun printstatus isvalid boolean n val message if isvalid ready else blocked n println message n caption one function answers a question the other performs output and implicitly returns unit. type callout tone remember title return facts before printing them text business rules are easier to reuse and test when they return values. keep console or ui presentation at an outer boundary. id defaults names decomposition title make calls clear and responsibilities small blocks type paragraph text a default parameter supplies a value when the caller omits that argument. named arguments make calls self documenting and allow selected defaults to be skipped. they are especially useful for adjacent arguments of the same type or unexplained boolean flags. defaults should represent a safe unsurprising common case. a function with too many configuration parameters may be revealing that several responsibilities or concepts need their own model. type code language kotlin code fun formatexpense n category string n amount double n currency string gbp n includelabel boolean true n string n val value currency amount n return if includelabel category value else value n n nval summary formatexpense n category travel n amount 8.25 n caption defaults keep the common call short while names make each supplied argument unambiguous. type flow title decompose a requirement steps id verb label find the verb detail identify one action or decision in the requirement. id inputs label list inputs detail name the information the decision needs. id output label choose output detail return the smallest useful result. id name label name function detail use a verb or question that states intent. id call label call and combine detail let an outer function coordinate smaller contracts. type paragraph text a useful function does one coherent job at one level of abstraction. validate an amount and format an approved expense are separate responsibilities even if one screen needs both. decomposition is not about making every line a function. it is about giving important rules names reducing duplication and allowing the caller to understand the program as a sequence of meaningful operations. furtherreading title create and use functions in kotlin publisher android developers resourcetype codelab url https developer.android.com codelabs basic android kotlin compose functions whyread a longer guided exercise covering declarations calls parameters return values defaults and named arguments. title functions publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs functions.html whyread the authoritative syntax and behaviour reference for parameters defaults named calls expression bodies and return types. inspect title separate validation from presentation language kotlin code fun isvalidexpense amount double category string boolean n return amount 0.0 category.isnotblank n n nfun expensesummary category string amount double string n category amount n nfun main n val amount 14.25 n val category food n n if isvalidexpense amount category n println expensesummary category amount n else n println invalid expense n n walkthrough isvalidexpense owns the rule and returns a boolean without printing. expensesummary owns text construction and returns a string. main coordinates the functions and chooses which result to present. expectedoutput food 14.25 trap check mistake printing a calculated result inside every business function. why the result becomes difficult to reuse in a ui test or another calculation. fix return the value and let an outer boundary decide how to present it. mistake using multiple unexplained boolean positional arguments. why a call such as format value true false hides what each boolean controls. fix use named arguments or replace flags with a clearer model. challenge intro task refactor one expense script into separate validation calculation and formatting functions. successlookslike each function has a clear contract business functions return values and main reads as a short coordination flow. recall prompt what is the difference between a parameter and an argument answer a parameter is declared by the function an argument is supplied by a caller. prompt what does unit communicate answer the function completes an action without returning a meaningful domain value. prompt why use named arguments answer they expose which parameter each value supplies and clarify otherwise ambiguous calls. kotlin functions parameters return values

documents.title: Null Safety and Uncertain Input
documents.text: null safety and uncertain input scout purpose real programs receive incomplete or invalid information so absence must be modelled instead of ignored. realworlduse android data can be missing from user input saved state databases network responses intents and platform apis. outcome represent optional values explicitly and handle them with checks safe calls elvis defaults and safe parsing. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id absence in the type title make absence visible in the type blocks type paragraph text kotlin distinguishes a non null type such as string from a nullable type such as string . a non null variable must refer to a string a nullable variable may also contain null. this moves many absence errors from runtime into compiler feedback. null should mean that a value is absent or not yet known. it should not be used interchangeably with an empty string zero or false because each of those values may have a legitimate domain meaning. type table title different states are different facts columns value possible meaning rows null no value is available a present but empty string 0 a known numeric value of zero false a known negative boolean answer type paragraph text after checking a stable nullable value against null kotlin can smart cast it inside the safe branch. the compiler permits normal string operations there because the condition proved the value is present. this reasoning works only when the compiler can guarantee the value cannot change between the check and its use. id safe call and elvis title transform or replace an absent value blocks type paragraph text the safe call operator . accesses a property or calls a function only when the receiver is non null otherwise the complete expression returns null. the elvis operator supplies an alternative when the expression on its left is null. together they can express a short safe transformation. use a default only when it preserves the domain meaning. silently replacing an absent price with zero may hide corrupted data while displaying unknown for an optional label may be appropriate. type code language kotlin code val rawcategory string travel nval category rawcategory .trim .takeif it.isnotempty nval displayname category uncategorised n nprintln displayname caption safe calls transform only a present value elvis supplies an explicit presentation fallback. type flow title handle a nullable value steps id receive label receive detail start with a value whose type permits null. id check label check or transform detail use an explicit branch or safe call. id decide label decide absence policy detail keep null return early report error or use a valid default. id continue label continue safely detail use a non null result where required. type callout tone warning title avoid casual double bang text the operator asserts that a value is non null and throws if the assertion is wrong. it removes compiler protection rather than solving absence. id safe parsing title treat external text as untrusted input blocks type paragraph text user input begins as text even when the screen asks for a number. calling todouble on invalid text throws an exception. the todoubleornull function returns a nullable double instead allowing the program to choose a clear validation path. parsing and domain validation are separate abc cannot be parsed while 5 parses successfully but may still violate the rule that an expense must be positive. type code language kotlin code fun parsepositiveamount text string double n val amount text.trim .todoubleornull n return if amount null amount 0.0 amount else null n n nfun main n val amount parsepositiveamount 12.50 n val message if amount null enter a positive number else accepted amount n println message n caption parsing failure and domain rejection both become an explicit nullable result for this small program. type paragraph text in larger applications a single null may not explain why validation failed. later lessons will introduce sealed result models that preserve specific error reasons. the first principle remains translate uncertain external data at the boundary then let the rest of the program work with stronger types and explicit outcomes. furtherreading title null safety publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs null safety.html whyread the complete official guide to nullable types smart casts safe calls elvis expressions and risky assertions. title strings conversion publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs strings.html#string conversion whyread shows parsing apis and their ornull alternatives for handling uncertain external text without avoidable exceptions. inspect title validate a possible amount language kotlin code fun amountmessage raw string string n val amount raw .trim .todoubleornull n return when n amount null enter a number n amount 0.0 amount must be positive n else accepted amount n n n nfun main n println amountmessage 18.75 n println amountmessage free n walkthrough the parameter type admits that no text may be supplied. a safe call chain stops with null if the input is absent or cannot be parsed. when distinguishes missing or invalid numeric text from a parsed non positive value. expectedoutput accepted 18.75 nenter a number trap check mistake using merely to silence a nullable type compiler error. why the assertion can move a detectable absence into a runtime nullpointerexception. fix choose an explicit absence policy with a check safe call elvis value or early return. mistake treating a parsed number as automatically valid domain data. why parsing proves only that the text has numeric form not that the value satisfies business rules. fix validate range and domain rules after parsing. challenge intro task write a function that accepts nullable amount text and returns either a usable positive value or a clear validation message. successlookslike invalid input never throws absence is handled deliberately and the valid path works with a non null number. recall prompt what does the question mark in string mean answer the type permits either a string value or null. prompt what does a safe call do when its receiver is null answer it skips the access or call and returns null for the expression. prompt why use todoubleornull for external text answer it represents invalid numeric text as null instead of throwing an exception. kotlin null safety input validation

documents.title: Designing a Small Program
documents.text: designing a small program scout purpose knowing syntax is not enough developers must turn a vague request into small verifiable program responsibilities. realworlduse every android feature begins as requirements that must be translated into inputs rules state changes outputs and failure behaviour. outcome decompose and trace a small expense program then diagnose errors using evidence. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id requirements to data title translate prose into program facts blocks type paragraph text begin with one observable requirement accept an expense amount and category reject invalid data and print an approved summary. underline the nouns to find data and the verbs to find behaviour. amount and category become inputs. accept reject and print become decisions or actions. write examples before code a positive amount and non blank category should succeed invalid numeric text zero negative amounts and blank categories should fail. examples make vague words such as valid concrete. type flow title from requirement to program steps id requirement label requirement detail state one observable user outcome. id examples label examples detail list successful and failing cases. id data label data detail choose names and types for required information. id rules label rules detail express validation and calculation decisions. id output label output detail present one result at the boundary. id verify label verify detail run examples and compare actual results. type paragraph text do not begin by creating many abstractions. a small program can use a few functions and basic types. extract a function when it names a business rule removes meaningful duplication or lets you reason about one responsibility in isolation. keep input and output near the program boundary so inner calculations are deterministic the same arguments should produce the same result. id pipeline title build a validation and transformation pipeline blocks type paragraph text a useful processing pipeline receives raw information normalises it parses it validates domain rules calculates derived values and presents a result. each stage should strengthen what is known. after parsing the program has a number instead of arbitrary text. after validation it has an amount permitted by the business rule. when a stage fails stop or return an explicit failure rather than allowing invalid data to travel deeper. type code language kotlin code fun parseamount raw string double raw.trim .todoubleornull n nfun isvalidexpense amount double category string boolean n amount 0.0 category.isnotblank n nfun summary amount double category string string n category amount caption three small functions separate boundary parsing domain validation and presentation. type table title pipeline responsibility columns stage question rows normalise can harmless formatting be removed parse can raw text become the required type validate does the typed value satisfy domain rules transform what result must be calculated present how should the outcome be communicated id debug with evidence title debug the first broken assumption blocks type paragraph text debugging is the process of finding where actual behaviour first diverges from expected behaviour. reproduce the problem with the smallest known input. read the first compiler error or capture the exact output. trace values at function boundaries. change one thing and rerun the same example. if the program compiles but gives the wrong result inspect assumptions about type operator order branch order loop boundaries and state updates before rewriting the whole solution. type code language kotlin code fun main n val rawamount 12.50 n val category food n val amount parseamount rawamount n n val message when n amount null amount is not a number n isvalidexpense amount category expense is invalid n else summary amount category n n n println message n caption main coordinates the pipeline and handles failure before calling functions that require a valid amount. type paragraph text a trace is temporary evidence not the final design. printing intermediate values can help in this console program later android work will use breakpoints structured logs tests and profilers. after fixing the cause remove noisy diagnostics and record the enduring rule as a clear name validation branch or automated test. the goal is not merely to make one example pass but to improve the program s explanation of its own behaviour. furtherreading title kotlin coding conventions publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs coding conventions.html whyread connects small program design to readable naming formatting immutability preferences and idiomatic kotlin structure. title introduction to programming in kotlin publisher android developers resourcetype guide url https developer.android.com courses pathways android basics compose unit 1 pathway 1 whyread collects the official first program variables functions practice and checkpoint material into one reinforcement pathway. title basic syntax overview publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs basic syntax.html whyread a compact reference to revisit while assembling the week 1 concepts into one complete console program. inspect title trace the complete expense path language kotlin code fun parseamount raw string double raw.trim .todoubleornull nfun isvalidexpense amount double category string amount 0.0 category.isnotblank nfun summary amount double category string category amount n nfun main n val rawamount 9.75 n val category travel n val amount parseamount rawamount n n if amount null n println enter a number n else if isvalidexpense amount category n println invalid expense n else n println summary amount category n n walkthrough raw text is converted at the boundary and represented as nullable when conversion may fail. the null branch returns a user facing failure path before validation receives a double. valid typed data flows through the business rule and then into presentation. expectedoutput travel 9.75 trap check mistake writing code before defining successful and failing examples. why words such as valid or correct remain ambiguous so the implementation has no precise target. fix list observable input output examples before choosing functions. mistake changing several functions while debugging one failing input. why multiple edits destroy the evidence needed to identify which assumption was wrong. fix reproduce trace the first divergence and make one focused change. challenge intro task complete the week 1 expense entry program with parsing validation summary output and at least five manually traced examples. successlookslike valid input succeeds invalid input never throws functions have focused contracts and the trace identifies each pipeline stage. recall prompt how do nouns and verbs help decompose a requirement answer nouns suggest data verbs suggest decisions transformations or actions. prompt what should each pipeline stage accomplish answer it should strengthen what the program knows or return an explicit failure. prompt where should debugging begin answer at the first point where actual behaviour differs from a reproducible expectation. kotlin problem solving debugging expense manager

documents.title: Classes, Objects, Interfaces, and Composition
documents.text: classes objects interfaces and composition scout purpose classes let a program place related state and behaviour behind a meaningful type instead of passing unrelated values everywhere. realworlduse android code uses classes for screen state holders repositories data sources workers services and adapters to platform apis. outcome design a small class with protected invariants an interface contract and collaboration through composition. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id objects and constructors title objects combine state and behaviour blocks type paragraph text a class describes a family of objects. its constructor receives the information required to create a valid instance properties retain relevant state and member functions expose behaviour. put a rule inside the type when every caller must obey it. an expense class should not require each screen or report to remember independently that an amount must be positive. keep constructor inputs small and meaningful an object that needs unrelated services flags and data often has more than one responsibility. type code language kotlin code class expense n val category string n val amount double n n init n require category.isnotblank n require amount 0.0 n n n fun summary string category amount n caption the constructor captures required state init protects invariants and summary exposes behaviour on valid objects. type callout tone remember title valid from construction text prefer preventing invalid objects at creation over allowing them and asking every later operation to check again. id interfaces and substitution title interfaces describe capabilities blocks type paragraph text an interface defines a contract without choosing one concrete implementation. callers depend on the capability they need such as expensestore.save rather than a specific file or database. an implementing class promises to honour the contract. interfaces are valuable at real variation boundaries external systems and test seams. creating an interface for every class adds names without adding flexibility so begin with concrete code and extract the boundary when there is a clear reason. type code language kotlin code interface expensestore n fun save expense expense n n nclass inmemoryexpensestore expensestore n private val items mutablelistof expense n n override fun save expense expense n items + expense n n caption the store contract hides where expenses are retained while the in memory implementation owns its mutable list. type table title choose the construct columns need construct rows create valid state with behaviour class represent one shared instance object declaration describe a replaceable capability interface add a specialised is a relationship inheritance used deliberately id composition title compose collaborators instead of building deep hierarchies blocks type paragraph text composition gives an object another object that performs a required role. expenseservice can receive an expensestore and coordinate validation or saving without inheriting store behaviour. this keeps the relationship explicit and replaceable. inheritance is appropriate when the subtype truly satisfies the parent contract and callers can use either safely. it is not a general code reuse tool. android framework types sometimes require inheritance but application level behaviour usually remains easier to change when assembled from focused collaborators. type code language kotlin code class expenseservice n private val store expensestore n n fun record category string amount double expense n val expense expense category amount n store.save expense n return expense n n caption expenseservice delegates storage through an injected capability and owns only the record workflow. type flow title a composed request steps id caller label caller detail supplies raw record information. id service label service detail coordinates the use case. id model label model detail protects expense invariants. id store label store detail persists through its contract. id result label result detail returns the valid recorded expense. type paragraph text composition also makes testing more direct pass a small fake collaborator invoke the use case and inspect the recorded interaction without constructing a framework hierarchy. furtherreading title classes publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs classes.html whyread the official guide to constructors properties initialisation members inheritance and class design syntax. title interfaces publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs interfaces.html whyread explains interface declarations implementations default members and resolving inherited contract conflicts. inspect title trace a composed recording flow language kotlin code interface expensestore fun save expense expense nclass consolestore expensestore n override fun save expense expense println saved expense.category n ndata class expense val category string val amount double nclass recorder private val store expensestore n fun record category string amount double n require amount 0.0 n store.save expense category amount n n nfun main recorder consolestore .record food 8.5 walkthrough consolestore fulfils the expensestore capability. recorder receives the abstraction through its constructor instead of creating storage internally. the valid request becomes an expense and is delegated to the supplied store. expectedoutput saved food trap check mistake adding inheritance only to reuse a helper function. why the subtype relationship becomes misleading and couples unrelated responsibilities. fix extract a collaborator or extension when there is no genuine is a contract. mistake leaving required properties mutable and publicly writable. why any caller can break the object invariant after construction. fix prefer val and expose focused methods for legitimate state changes. challenge intro task build expense expensestore inmemoryexpensestore and expenserecorder so invalid expenses cannot be created and storage can be replaced. successlookslike expense construction rejects blank categories and non positive amounts. recorder depends on expensestore rather than a concrete list. the in memory implementation does not expose its mutable collection. recall prompt what should a constructor guarantee answer it should gather required inputs and create an object whose invariants hold. prompt when does an interface earn its place answer at a meaningful capability variation boundary external dependency or test seam. prompt what does composition make explicit answer which focused collaborators an object uses to perform its responsibility. kotlin classes interfaces composition

documents.title: Data Classes, Enums, and Sealed Models
documents.text: data classes enums and sealed models scout purpose kotlin provides specialised types for value records fixed labels and closed alternatives choosing the right one makes invalid states sealed types based on identity and alternatives then handle closed states exhaustively. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id data values title data classes model values blocks type paragraph text a data class is suited to records whose meaning comes primarily from their property values. the compiler provides value based equals hashcode tostring component functions and copy. prefer val properties so a state transition creates a new value instead of mutating shared state. copy is shallow nested mutable objects are still shared unless they are also replaced or designed immutably. data classes do not validate automatically constructor and factory rules still matter. type code language kotlin code data class expensedraft n val category string n val amounttext string n val note string n n nval same simple concept such as an expense category or sort direction. enum entries may have properties and functions but large amounts of entry specific behaviour can become difficult to scan. persisting enum ordinal values is fragile because reordering entries changes their numbers. prefer a stable explicit code when an enum crosses storage or network boundaries and define how unknown future values a load result may be loading success with expenses or failure with an explanation. the closed hierarchy documents every state the consumer must consider. do not use a sealed type for an ecosystem walkthrough expense is a value record with generated equality. each saveresult alternative carries data suited to that outcome. when is exhaustive because every direct sealed alternative is handled. independent values. fix expose read only immutable data or replace nested values during a transition. mistake persisting an enum ordinal as permanent data. why reordering or inserting entries changes documents.title: Collections and Transformation Pipelines
documents.text: collections and transformation pipelines scout purpose collections let one operation describe how a group of values should be selected transformed grouped or summarised. realworlduse android applications transform database rows network models ui lists settings search results and analytics events through collection operations. outcome choose list set or map control mutability and build readable eager transformation pipelines. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id collection shapes title choose the shape from the question blocks type paragraph text a list preserves order and permits duplicates. a set represents membership with unique elements. a map associates unique keys with values. choose based on the domain question not convenience transaction history is ordered selected tag ids are unique and expenses by id form a lookup. kotlin separates read only interfaces from mutable interfaces. a val holding mutablelist cannot be reassigned but the list can still change. expose the narrowest read only view that callers need and keep mutation close to its owner. type table title collection choice columns question type rows does order and repetition matter list t is membership unique set t do unique keys locate values map k v must this owner add or remove a mutable variant kept private type code language kotlin code class expensebook n private val entries mutablelistof expense n val expenses list expense get entries.tolist n n fun add expense expense entries + expense n caption mutation stays private and callers receive a snapshot that they cannot modify through this api. id operators title transform without changing the source blocks type paragraph text operations such as filter map sortedby distinctby groupby associateby and fold return results derived from the receiver. name intermediate results when a long chain mixes several ideas. filter keeps elements satisfying a predicate map changes each element groupby builds lists under a key associateby expects one value per key and later duplicates overwrite earlier ones. select the operation whose output shape matches the next step. type code language kotlin code val traveltotalsbyday expenses n .filter it.category expensecategory.travel n .groupby it.day n .mapvalues daily daily.sumof expense amount n .tosortedmap caption the pipeline selects travel items groups them reduces each group then orders the keyed result. type flow title read a collection chain steps id source label source detail identify element type and mutability. id select label select detail filter only values that qualify. id shape label transform detail map group or associate into a new shape. id reduce label reduce detail summarise when one result is required. id consume label consume detail present or return the final type. id eager costs title understand allocation and failure choices blocks type paragraph text standard collection chains are eager each intermediate operator commonly creates a new collection. for ordinary screen sized data this clarity is often the right tradeoff. for large pipelines sequence may avoid intermediate collections but adds its own overhead and should be measured. functions such as first and single throw when their assumptions fail while firstornull and singleornull represent uncertainty. use throwing variants only when absence proves an internal invariant is broken not when empty data is expected. type code language kotlin code fun largestexpense expenses list expense expense n expenses.maxbyornull expense amount n nfun totalbycategory expenses list expense map expensecategory double n expenses.groupby expense category n .mapvalues values values.sumof expense amount caption nullable and keyed results communicate the possible empty input and output shape. type callout tone remember title clarity before cleverness text prefer a readable eager pipeline first. change representation only after data size and measurement reveal a real problem. type paragraph text when two operations produce the same result prefer the one whose name communicates the domain step and whose intermediate values remain easy to inspect during debugging. furtherreading title collections overview publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs collections overview.html whyread introduces list set map read only and mutable interfaces hierarchy equality and variance. title collection operations overview publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs collection operations.html whyread maps the standard selection transformation grouping ordering aggregation and retrieval operations. inspect title trace a grouped total language kotlin code data class expense val category string val amount double nfun main n val expenses listof n expense food 5.0 n expense travel 8.0 n expense food 3.0 n n val totals expenses.groupby it.category n .mapvalues items items.sumof it.amount n println totals n walkthrough groupby produces a map string list expense . mapvalues keeps each key and transforms its list into a double total. linked insertion order makes the printed keys follow their first appearance in this example. expectedoutput food 8.0 travel 8.0 trap check mistake returning a private mutablelist through a list typed property without copying. why the underlying object may still be mutated through another retained mutable reference. fix return an immutable snapshot or use an immutable collection implementation. mistake calling single when zero values are a normal outcome. why the function throws for empty and multi element inputs. fix use singleornull or model the expected cardinality explicitly. challenge intro task transform a list of expenses into totals by category highest expense unique categories and a sorted list of positive records. successlookslike every requested output uses a collection operation whose result type fits the requirement. the source list is not mutated. empty input is handled without an unexpected exception. recall prompt which collection represents unique membership answer set represents a group whose elements are unique. prompt what output does groupby produce answer a map from each key to the list of elements sharing that key. prompt when should sequence be introduced answer when measured workload characteristics justify changing a clear eager pipeline. kotlin collections immutability pipelines

documents.title: Lambdas, Higher-Order Functions, and Extensions
documents.text: lambdas higher order functions and extensions scout purpose treating behaviour as a value lets kotlin apis separate a reusable operation from the policy supplied by each caller. realworlduse compose event callbacks collection operators coroutine builders configuration blocks listeners and test helpers all rely on lambdas and function types. outcome read function types write focused lambdas and higher order functions and use extensions or scope functions without hiding control flow. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id function values title functions can receive behaviour blocks type paragraph text a function type describes inputs and output such as expense boolean for a rule that receives an expense and returns a boolean. a lambda is an unnamed function value. its parameters appear before and its last expression becomes the result. higher order functions accept or return functions. this is how filter receives a caller defined predicate while keeping traversal reusable. give complex lambdas named functions when the policy deserves a domain name or is reused. type code language kotlin code val islarge expense boolean expense n expense.amount 100.0 n n nfun countmatching n expenses list expense n predicate expense boolean n int expenses.count predicate caption the higher order function owns iteration and the supplied lambda owns the matching policy. type table title function type parts columns syntax meaning rows expense boolean one expense input and boolean output unit no input and action like output a b r two inputs and one result suspend t suspending behaviour that eventually produces t id extensions title extensions improve local vocabulary blocks type paragraph text an extension function is called with receiver syntax but does not modify the receiver class or gain private access. resolution is static from the declared receiver type so an extension cannot provide runtime polymorphism. extensions work well for focused transformations closely associated with an existing type especially at application boundaries. avoid broad public extensions with generic names because they pollute completion and can collide. keep visibility as narrow as practical. type code language kotlin code fun string.topositiveamountornull double n trim .todoubleornull .takeif it 0.0 n nfun expense.formatted string n category.displayname .2f .format amount caption each extension adds a small domain operation while using only the receiver public api. type callout tone warning title no new member exists text extension dispatch is static. if subtype specific behaviour is required use a member or interface contract instead. id scope functions title use scope functions for one clear purpose blocks type paragraph text let run with apply and also execute a block with an object in scope but differ in receiver name and returned value. choose from intent apply configures and returns the receiver also performs an additional side effect and returns the receiver let transforms using it run computes using this with is a non extension form. deep nesting and switching between this and it make control flow opaque. a normal local variable is often clearer. type code language kotlin code val draft expensedraft .copy category food n nval amount rawamount n .topositiveamountornull n .also println parsed amount it n return caption the extension owns parsing also observes the present value and elvis exits on absence. type flow title choose a scope construct steps id need label state intent detail configure transform compute or observe id receiver label choose receiver name detail will this or it be clearer id return label choose result detail return receiver or block result id simplify label check clarity detail prefer ordinary code if the chain hides flow. type paragraph text name important lambdas when they encode business policy. a declaration such as isreimbursable communicates intent more clearly than repeating a dense predicate in several collection chains. furtherreading title higher order functions and lambdas publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs lambdas.html whyread the full reference for function types lambda syntax closures receivers and higher order function behaviour. title extensions publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs extensions.html whyread explains static extension resolution nullable receivers extension properties scope and member extensions. title scope functions publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs scope functions.html whyread compares let run with apply and also by receiver access return value and intended use. inspect title pass an expense policy language kotlin code data class expense val category string val amount double nfun list expense .totalwhere rule expense boolean double n filter rule .sumof it.amount nfun main n val items listof expense food 5.0 expense travel 12.0 n val traveltotal items.totalwhere it.category travel n println traveltotal n walkthrough the extension receiver is a list expense . totalwhere accepts caller supplied policy as a function value. the lambda selects travel and the shared pipeline sums the selected amount. expectedoutput 12.0 trap check mistake nesting several scope functions using both this and it. why the reader loses track of receivers returned values and early exits. fix name intermediate values or replace the nesting with ordinary statements. mistake expecting an extension to override a member at runtime. why extensions are resolved statically and members take precedence. fix use an interface or open member for polymorphic behaviour. challenge intro task add parsing and formatting extensions plus a higher order report function that accepts different expense selection policies. successlookslike function types make selection policy explicit. extensions remain focused and have narrow visibility. the solution avoids nested scope function chains. recall prompt what does expense boolean describe answer a function value taking one expense and returning a boolean. prompt can an extension access private receiver state answer no it uses the same visible api as ordinary external code. prompt what should decide scope function choice answer the intended receiver name returned value and clarity of the operation. kotlin lambdas higher order functions extensions

documents.title: Exceptions and Explicit Result Modelling
documents.text: exceptions and explicit result modelling scout purpose reliable programs distinguish expected unsuccessful outcomes from exceptional failures and preserve enough information for callers to respond. realworlduse files databases networks parsing permissions and platform apis fail differently repositories must translate those failures into useful application outcomes. outcome throw or catch at deliberate boundaries and model recoverable domain outcomes without losing cancellation or diagnostic causes. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id exception semantics title exceptions interrupt normal control flow blocks type paragraph text an exception reports that the current operation cannot finish normally. throw is an expression and try can produce a value. catch the most specific exception you can actually handle a broad catch can hide programmer defects and make unrelated failures look identical. finally performs cleanup whether the operation succeeds or throws. use require for invalid caller arguments check for invalid object state and error for an impossible branch but do not use exceptions as routine branching for expected user input. type code language kotlin code fun readamount text string double n text.todoubleornull n throw illegalargumentexception amount must be numeric n nval amount try n readamount raw n catch error illegalargumentexception n return saveoutcome.invalid error.message invalid amount n caption the boundary translates one anticipated parsing exception into a domain outcome instead of swallowing every throwable. type table title failure policy columns situation representation rows expected invalid input validation or domain result broken caller precondition require and illegalargumentexception broken internal state check and illegalstateexception external operation failure catch narrowly and translate or propagate cancellation propagate do not convert into generic failure id result types title return expected alternatives explicitly blocks type paragraph text a sealed result makes every expected outcome visible in the function type. success can carry the saved expense invalid can carry field problems and storagefailure can retain a safe message plus a diagnostic cause for logging. the caller handles the hierarchy exhaustively. kotlin result is useful at some generic boundaries but a domain specific sealed type communicates more meaning and can represent multiple distinct failures without relying on exception classes as product language. type code language kotlin code sealed interface saveoutcome n data class saved val expense expense saveoutcome n data class invalid val problems list string saveoutcome n data class storagefailure val cause throwable saveoutcome n caption the return type documents three expected paths and gives each path appropriate data. type flow title translate a failure steps id detect label detect detail identify the precise failing operation. id classify label classify detail expected outcome or exceptional defect id preserve label preserve detail keep safe user context and diagnostic cause. id translate label translate detail return a domain result at the boundary. id handle label handle detail let the caller respond exhaustively. id boundaries title catch where policy exists blocks type paragraph text a catch block should sit where the program knows what the failure means and what to do next. low level code may let an ioexception propagate to a repository which can map it to an offline or storage outcome. logging and rethrowing at every layer duplicates noise. never use catch throwable for ordinary recovery because it includes serious runtime errors and cancellation like control signals. preserve the original cause when wrapping and avoid exposing sensitive file paths or raw service messages directly to users. type code language kotlin code fun saveexpense store expensestore expense expense saveoutcome n try n store.save expense n saveoutcome.saved expense n catch error java.io.ioexception n saveoutcome.storagefailure error n caption the application boundary knows an i o failure is an expected storage outcome and preserves its cause. type callout tone remember title recovery requires policy text catching is useful only when the current layer can translate retry compensate clean up or communicate the failure meaningfully. furtherreading title exceptions publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs exceptions.html whyread the official reference for throw try expressions catch ordering finally checks and exception creation. title result publisher kotlin standard library resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org api core kotlin stdlib kotlin result whyread documents kotlin result operations and helps compare a generic success failure container with domain specific outcomes. inspect title translate storage failure language kotlin code sealed interface outcome n data object saved outcome n data class failed val cause throwable outcome n nfun save write unit outcome try n write n outcome.saved n catch error java.io.ioexception n outcome.failed error n nfun main n println save throw java.io.ioexception disk full is outcome.failed n walkthrough the higher order parameter isolates the fallible write operation. only ioexception is translated unrelated programming defects remain visible. the diagnostic cause is retained inside the explicit failure outcome. expectedoutput true trap check mistake catching exception and returning null for every failure. why the caller cannot distinguish absence invalid input cancellation or a broken invariant. fix catch narrowly and return an outcome that preserves useful meaning. mistake logging and rethrowing at every layer. why one failure creates duplicated logs without adding handling policy. fix log once at an observability boundary with relevant context. challenge intro task refactor an expense save function so validation successful storage and i o failure are distinct explicit outcomes with preserved diagnostics. successlookslike expected invalid data does not throw. only the anticipated storage exception is translated. every outcome is handled exhaustively by the caller. recall prompt when should a layer catch an exception answer when it has a policy to translate recover clean up or communicate it. prompt why use a sealed domain result answer it makes expected outcomes explicit and exhaustively handled. prompt what should wrapping an exception preserve answer the original cause and safe context needed for diagnosis. kotlin exceptions result models failure

documents.title: Generics, Variance, and Type-Safe Reuse
documents.text: generics variance and type safe reuse scout purpose generics reuse algorithms and containers while preserving the specific type of data moving through them. realworlduse collections flow repositories serializers ui state navigation results and dependency containers rely heavily on generic apis. outcome declare bounded type parameters and reason about invariance producers consumers and projections without unsafe casts. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id type parameters title parameterise types not safety blocks type paragraph text a type parameter stands for a type chosen at each use site. box t can hold an expense or a string while keeping those uses distinct. generic functions express relationships between input and output types that any would erase. constraints such as t comparable t restrict the accepted types to those providing required behaviour. use a generic only when the implementation genuinely works across a family of types a domain specific function is clearer when rules depend on expense semantics. type code language kotlin code data class page t n val items list t n val nextcursor string n n nfun t page t .islast boolean nextcursor null caption page preserves its element type while reusable paging metadata and behaviour remain identical. type table title generic vocabulary columns term example rows type parameter t in class box t type argument expense in box expense upper bound t comparable t star projection box when the contained type is unknown type erasure most generic arguments are unavailable at jvm runtime id invariance title mutable generic types are invariant for safety blocks type paragraph text even if cardexpense is a subtype of expense mutablelist cardexpense is not a subtype of mutablelist expense . if it were a function receiving the broader list could insert a cashexpense and corrupt the original collection. read only list is declared covariant because callers only receive elements. variance describes how subtype relationships transfer through a generic type not whether one value can be cast successfully in a particular test. type code language kotlin code open class expense nclass cardexpense expense nclass cashexpense expense n nfun addcash items mutablelist expense n items + cashexpense n n n addcash mutablelistof cardexpense rejected safely caption invariance prevents a broader writer from inserting the wrong subtype into a specialised mutable list. type callout tone remember title mutation changes variance text a type that both consumes and produces t is normally invariant because either direction alone would be unsafe. id producer consumer title use out for producers and in for consumers blocks type paragraph text a producer returns values of t but does not accept them so it may declare out t. a consumer accepts t but does not return it so it may declare in t. remember producer out consumer in. declaration site variance documents the whole type use site projections restrict one particular parameter. star projections are useful when only non type specific operations are safe. avoid adding variance until the api role is genuinely one directional. type code language kotlin code interface source out t n fun load t n ninterface sink in t n fun save value t n nfun copyexpense source source expense sink sink expense n sink.save source.load n caption the source only produces and the sink only consumes allowing safe variance at each boundary. type flow title variance decision steps id role label find role detail does the api produce consume or do both id produce label producer detail consider out t when t only leaves. id consume label consumer detail consider in t when t only enters. id both label both detail keep t invariant. id verify label verify detail check every member signature for the claimed direction. type paragraph text variance is an api promise checked across every member so begin from how values cross the boundary rather than adding out or in until a compiler error disappears. furtherreading title generics in out where publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs generics.html whyread the authoritative guide to type parameters bounds declaration site variance projections stars and erasure. title collections overview publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs collections overview.html whyread shows how covariance differs between read only and mutable collection interfaces in a familiar api. inspect title copy through variant boundaries language kotlin code interface source out t fun load t ninterface sink in t fun save value t ndata class expense val amount double nclass oneexpense source expense override fun load expense 7.5 nclass printany sink any override fun save value any println value nfun main n val source source expense oneexpense n val sink sink expense printany n sink.save source.load n walkthrough source produces expense and is covariant. a sink capable of accepting any can safely stand in for a sink of expense. the copied value keeps its concrete data without a cast. expectedoutput expense amount 7.5 trap check mistake replacing a type parameter with any and casting later. why the compiler can no longer protect the relationship between inputs and outputs. fix express the relationship with a generic parameter and bounds. mistake marking t as out while accepting t in a public function. why the consumer position contradicts the covariance promise. fix keep the type invariant or separate producer and consumer capabilities. challenge intro task design generic source and sink apis for importing expenses with variance that allows specialised producers and broad consumers safely. successlookslike no unchecked cast is required. producer and consumer directions match their declarations. a specialised expense source can copy into a sink that accepts any. recall prompt why is mutablelist invariant answer it both accepts and returns elements so broader substitution could corrupt its element type. prompt what mnemonic explains variance directions answer producer out and consumer in. prompt what does a generic bound provide answer it restricts type arguments to values supporting required behaviour. kotlin generics variance type safety

mechanical forwarding methods. property delegates move get and set behaviour into another object lazy calculates once on first access observable reports changes and custom delegates can enforce and require disciplined boundaries. realworlduse android build tools room dependency injection serialization compose tests and navigation use annotations generated code reflection or kotlin dsl patterns. outcome explain annotation processing and reflection costs then design a small receiver based builder whose scope remains unambiguous. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id annotations title annotations attach machine readable metadata blocks type paragraph text an annotation records metadata on a declaration type expression or generated jvm element. target states where it may appear and retention controls whether it exists only in source in compiled output or at runtime. frameworks can process annotations during compilation to generate code or inspect runtime annotations through reflection. use site targets such as field get or param matter when one kotlin property produces several jvm elements. type code language kotlin code target annotationtarget.class n retention annotationretention.runtime nannotation class contenttype val name string n n contenttype expense ndata class expense val amount double caption the annotation carries a stable metadata value and is retained for runtime inspection. type table title retention tradeoff columns retention available to typical use rows source source tools only static analysis hints binary compiled artifact not reflection compiler and bytecode tooling runtime runtime reflection dynamic discovery when justified id reflection generation title prefer generated direct code when practical blocks type paragraph text reflection inspects declarations or invokes behaviour dynamically. it reduces compile time knowledge may need extra metadata complicates shrinking and is harder to trace than a direct call. compile time generation preserves typed inspectable code and often reports errors earlier. room and many dependency injection tools generate implementations from annotations. reflection remains valid for tools and genuinely dynamic systems isolate it behind a small adapter and cache repeated discovery instead of spreading reflective lookup through domain code. type code language kotlin code fun contentname type kotlin.reflect.kclass string n type.annotations n .filterisinstance contenttype n .firstornull n .name n nprintln contentname expense class caption a small reflection boundary reads one known annotation and returns ordinary nullable data. type callout tone remember title metadata needs a consumer text an annotation alone changes nothing. generated code a compiler plugin static analysis or runtime logic must interpret it. id builders title dsls use receivers to constrain vocabulary blocks type paragraph text a type safe builder is usually a higher order function with a documents.text: terminal files and running programs scout purpose a developer must be able to locate a project run a tool interpret its result and change files deliberately instead of treating the front end. outcome navigate paths distinguish files from directories run a command with arguments and explain working directory exit status standard output and standard error. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id filesystem title a path locates an item in a directory tree blocks type paragraph text a filesystem organises named files inside directories. an absolute path begins at the filesystem root and identifies one location independently of the current directory. a relative path begins from the process working directory. the dot segment means the current directory and two dots mean its parent. before editing or deleting anything print the working directory and list the target. spaces are part of a name so quote a path such as my project rather than allowing the shell to split it into two arguments. file extensions are conventions that help tools and people the file content remains the decisive evidence. type code language shell code pwd nls ncd my project nls src n# . gradlew refers to gradlew in the current directory caption each relative name is resolved from the shell working directory. quoting preserves a path containing spaces as one argument. type table title path forms columns form meaning rows projects droidquest absolute path from the root data content relative path from the working directory . current directory .. parent directory . gradlew executable named gradlew in the current directory id commands title a command starts a process with arguments blocks type paragraph text the shell parses a command line into a program name and ordered arguments. it then starts a process an executing instance of that program. environment variables provide inherited configuration while command flags select behaviour for one invocation. standard input supplies data standard output carries normal results and standard error carries diagnostics. these are streams not promises about whether work succeeded. read the program exit status as well zero normally means success and a non zero value identifies a failure category. never paste an unfamiliar command into a terminal until you can identify its executable arguments targets and side effects. type code language shell code node version nnpm run validate necho # exit status of the previous command in many shells caption node and npm are executables the remaining tokens are arguments. the final status communicates success separately from printed text. type flow title command lifecycle steps id parse label parse detail shell turns text into a program and arguments. id start label start process detail operating system creates an executing process. id streams label exchange streams detail process reads input and writes output or diagnostics. id status label exit detail process returns a numeric status to its caller. id safe workflow title inspect act narrowly then verify blocks type paragraph text command line confidence comes from a repeatable safety loop. establish context with pwd inspect names with a directory listing and ask a tool for help before guessing flags. prefer a read only command first. make the smallest intended change with an exact path then rerun inspection or tests to verify the outcome. tab completion reduces spelling mistakes and command history helps reproduce work but both can repeat a dangerous target quickly. recursive deletion broad globs administrator privileges and commands downloaded from the internet deserve an explicit pause because they can affect far more than one file. a terminal is powerful because it is precise supply that precision yourself. type code language shell code pwd nfind content lessons name level 01 week 04 .json maxdepth 1 nnpm run test content caption the sequence establishes context performs a read only targeted inspection and asks the project test to verify content. type callout tone warning title resolve the target first text do not run a destructive command against an unresolved variable broad directory or pattern you have not inspected. furtherreading title pro git the command line publisher git project resourcetype official docs url https git scm.com book en v2 getting started the command and may change or fail against the wrong files. fix print the working directory and inspect the exact target first. mistake treating printed output as proof of success. why a program can emit diagnostics and still return a failing status. fix read the exit status and verify the intended artifact or state. challenge intro task write a small shell checklist or script that confirms it is inside the droidquest data directory reports relevant json file counts and runs content validation without modifying files. successlookslike the working directory is checked before relative paths are
