documents.text: git pull requests and useful documentation scout purpose version control creates a reviewable history of intent while documentation and pull requests let a team understand why a change exists and whether it is safe to integrate. realworlduse android applications combine source gradle configuration resources schemas and tests git coordinates changes across all of them and ci checks proposed integrations. outcome create focused commits reason about branches and merges prepare a reviewable pull request and write documentation that answers future maintainers real questions. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id snapshots title git records connected snapshots blocks type paragraph text a repository stores project history. the working tree is what you currently see the staging area selects the exact changes intended for the next commit and a commit records a snapshot with metadata and parent links. git content is not automatically saved merely because a file changed. inspect status and the staged diff before committing so unrelated work is not captured. a strong commit represents one coherent reason keeps the project usable where practical and has a message that explains the outcome rather than narrating keystrokes. history becomes an engineering tool when another person can revert compare or diagnose it. type code language shell code git status ngit diff ngit add content lessons new lesson.json ngit diff staged ngit commit m add week 4 terminal lesson caption the working diff is inspected one intended file is staged and the exact staged snapshot is reviewed before commit. type table title git states columns state question rows working tree what differs from the checked out commit staging area what exactly will the next commit contain commit what durable snapshot and intent are recorded branch which movable name points to the current line of work id branches review title a branch isolates a line of work a pull request hosts review blocks type paragraph text a branch is a movable reference to a commit not a full copy of the project. new commits advance the current branch. merging joins histories and a conflict means git cannot choose a correct combined result from text alone. resolve conflicts by understanding both intents then run the relevant checks. a pull request proposes integrating one branch and provides a durable conversation around the diff. its description should state the problem approach evidence risks and any manual review required. review code for correctness and maintainability and review generated content or assets for semantic quality not merely whether ci is green. type code language shell code git switch c level 1 week 4 ngit log oneline decorate 5 ngit diff main...head caption the branch outcome. id commit label commit detail record coherent reviewed snapshots. id push label share branch detail publish the proposed history. id pr label open pull request detail explain intent evidence and risk. id review label review and revise detail address findings and rerun checks. id merge label merge detail integrate after required evidence passes. id documentation title document decisions and operating knowledge blocks type paragraph text good documentation serves a specific reader and task. a readme should explain what the repository is how to validate it and where deeper guidance lives. an authoring guide records repeatable content rules. comments should explain a surprising constraint or decision not translate obvious syntax. a decision record captures context alternatives the chosen direction and consequences when a design choice will matter later. keep commands executable examples current and links stable. documentation is part of the change update it in the same pull request and review it against the actual behaviour. old confident instructions are more dangerous than an honest gap. type code language markdown code ## validate content n n sh nnpm install nnpm run test content n n nthe command validates source json regenerates indexes and checks generated output. caption this documentation names the task gives reproducible commands and explains the expected result. type callout tone remember title write for the next decision text document what a maintainer needs to operate or change the system including constraints and verification not a diary of integrate branch changes. title how to write and format different types of source code documentation publisher google for developers resourcetype guide url https developers.google.com tech writing one whyread introduces audience focused documentation clear sentences lists and useful code examples. inspect title review a focused history language kotlin code git status ngit diff staged ngit log oneline decorate 3 walkthrough status reveals untracked modified and staged paths. the staged diff is the proposed commit so it deserves review before recording. the concise log shows commit boundaries and the branch pointer. expectedoutput a reviewer should be able to connect each staged change to one stated outcome. trap check mistake using git add . without reviewing unrelated changes. why the commit may capture secrets generated noise or another unfinished task. fix stage exact paths and inspect git diff staged before committing. mistake writing a pull request description that only a documentation only commit that explains how to validate droidquest content then draft a pull request description with purpose evidence and risks. successlookslike the staged diff contains only the documents.title: Debugging with Evidence
documents.text: debugging with evidence scout purpose debugging is the disciplined reduction of uncertainty reproduce a failure gather evidence test a specific explanation and verify the smallest repair. realworlduse android failures surface through compiler diagnostics logcat exceptions stack traces breakpoints inspectors and device specific state. outcome read a stack trace choose useful breakpoints and observations distinguish symptoms from causes and verify a fix with a regression check. learn estimatedminutes 9 sections id hypothesis title reproduce before explaining blocks type paragraph text a bug report describes an observed mismatch between expected and actual behaviour. begin by making that mismatch reproducible with precise inputs environment and steps. reduce the failing case until irrelevant variables disappear. then state a falsifiable hypothesis the parser accepts a blank amount because trim occurs after validation is testable the app is broken is not. change one relevant variable or add one focused observation. random edits destroy information because success no longer identifies which assumption was wrong. if reproduction is intermittent record timing device build data and logs instead of pretending the uncertainty does not exist. type code language kotlin code fun parseamount raw string double n require raw.isnotblank amount is blank n return raw.trim .todouble n n nfun main n println parseamount n caption the smallest failing input isolates blank validation from ui persistence and networking concerns. type flow title evidence loop steps id reproduce label reproduce detail capture expected result actual result input and environment. id localise label localise detail reduce the failing path and identify the first wrong state. id hypothesis label hypothesise detail state one explanation that evidence can disprove. id experiment label experiment detail observe or change one relevant condition. id verify label verify detail run the reproduction and broader regression checks. id stack title read a stack trace from the exception outward blocks type paragraph text an exception report names the exception type its message and stack frames describing active calls. in a typical jvm trace the first frame beneath the exception is where that exception was thrown following frames show callers moving outward. start with the first frame belonging to your code then inspect inputs and earlier state. a caused by section records a wrapped underlying exception and may contain the actionable origin. line numbers refer to a particular build so use matching source. the deepest frame is not automatically the root cause invalid data may have been created much earlier and only detected at the throw site. type code language text code exception in thread main java.lang.illegalargumentexception amount is blank n at expenseparser.parseamount expenseparser.kt 8 n at expenseimporter.importline expenseimporter.kt 21 n at mainkt.main main.kt 5 caption read from parseamount where failure was detected outward through importline to the entry point. type table title trace evidence columns part question rows exception type what failure category was reported message what detail did the throwing code provide top relevant frame where was the failure detected in our code caller frames which path supplied this state caused by was another exception wrapped underneath id tools title observe state without changing the question blocks type paragraph text a breakpoint pauses execution before or after a chosen line so a debugger can inspect variables evaluate limited expressions and step through calls. place it near the first wrong state not merely at application startup. step over executes a line without entering called functions step into follows a relevant call and step out completes the current function. logging is better for timing sensitive or remote failures but logs need stable context and must not expose credentials or private user data. after repair encode the original reproduction as a test when possible. a fix is not verified because the exception disappeared once expected behaviour and nearby cases must still hold. type code language kotlin code fun parseamount raw string result double runcatching n val normalised raw.trim inspect raw and normalised here n require normalised.isnotempty amount is blank n normalised.todouble n caption a breakpoint after normalisation reveals whether the state first becomes wrong before validation. type callout tone warning title debugger evaluation can have side effects text avoid calling mutating functions from the debugger an observation that changes state can hide the original failure. furtherreading title debug your app publisher android developers resourcetype official docs url https developer.android.com studio debug whyread covers debuggable builds breakpoints stepping watches variable inspection and android studio debugger controls. title analyze a stack trace publisher android developers resourcetype official docs url https developer.android.com studio debug stacktraces whyread shows how stack traces identify exceptions frames source locations and obfuscated release code. inspect title localise an invalid amount language kotlin code fun average values list double double values.sum values.size nfun main n val values emptylist double n println average values n walkthrough reproduction fixes the relevant input as an empty list. a breakpoint inside average reveals size is zero before division. the domain question is whether empty input should be rejected or represented explicitly not how to hide the printed result. expectedoutput the program prints nan a verified repair must define and test empty list behaviour. trap check mistake editing several suspected lines before reproducing. why any changed behaviour is impossible to attribute and new defects may be introduced. fix create a minimal reproduction and test one hypothesis at a time. mistake stopping when the visible exception disappears. why the symptom may be hidden while invalid state still exists or another case regresses. fix verify expected output and add the original reproduction as a regression test. challenge intro task given a small expense import program and a repeatable exception write a debugging record containing reproduction stack trace interpretation one hypothesis experiment repair and regression checks. successlookslike the first wrong state is distinguished from the final symptom. only one hypothesis is tested in the experiment. verification includes the original failure and at least two nearby cases. recall prompt where do you begin reading a jvm stack trace answer at the exception and first relevant application frame then outward through callers and causes. prompt what makes a debugging hypothesis useful answer it predicts evidence that can confirm or disprove one explanation. prompt why add a regression test answer it proves the original failure is repaired and guards against its return. debugging stack traces breakpoints tooling

documents.title: Data Structures and Practical Complexity
documents.text: data structures and practical complexity scout purpose choosing a representation determines which operations are simple which invariants are visible and how work grows as data becomes larger. realworlduse ui lists caches indexes deduplication navigation stacks queues and database adapters all depend on deliberate collection and algorithm choices. outcome select lists sets maps stacks and queues by required operations then compare constant linear and logarithmic growth without premature optimisation. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id operations title choose for operations and invariants blocks type paragraph text a data structure is an organisation of values together with supported operations. a list preserves order and permits duplicates indexed access is direct while searching for an unknown value generally scans elements. a set represents uniqueness and answers membership efficiently in typical hash based implementations. a map associates unique keys with values and is useful when lookup begins with an identifier. a stack removes the most recently added item while a queue removes the earliest waiting item. the best choice follows the domain invariant and dominant operations not habit. if order matters and duplicates are meaningful a set would destroy information even if membership is fast. type code language kotlin code val ordered listof food travel food nval unique ordered.toset nval byid expenses.associateby it.id n nval found byid expenseid expense 7 caption each transformation changes the contract ordered retains repetition unique removes it and byid enables key based lookup. type table title structure selection columns structure preserves order duplicates typical strength rows list yes yes iteration and indexed sequence set implementation dependent no membership and uniqueness map implementation dependent keys no lookup by key stack deque access order yes last in first out work queue deque access order yes first in first out work id growth title complexity describes growth not stopwatch time blocks type paragraph text time complexity compares how operation counts grow with input size n. constant o 1 work does not grow with n in the model linear o n work grows proportionally logarithmic o log n repeatedly reduces the remaining search space quadratic o n2 often compares many pairs. big o omits hardware constants allocation and small input effects so it predicts scalability rather than exact duration. a hash map lookup is typically constant average time but can degrade with collisions. binary search is logarithmic only when data is sorted and supports efficient indexed access. always state the operation assumptions and data size instead of labelling an entire feature fast. type code language kotlin code fun containsduplicate values list string boolean n val seen mutablesetof string n for value in values n if seen.add value return true n n return false n caption one pass performs typical constant time set insertions giving expected o n time and o n additional space. type flow title growth comparison steps id constant label o 1 detail direct map lookup by known key under typical hashing. id log label o log n detail binary search halves sorted search space. id linear label o n detail scan every expense once. id nlogn label o n log n detail typical comparison sorting. id quadratic label o n2 detail compare every item with many others. id tradeoffs title improve representation before clever loops blocks type paragraph text performance choices trade time memory ordering and implementation complexity. building a map costs linear time and extra space but pays off when many later lookups use the key. for one lookup in a tiny list a scan may be clearer. maintain invariants at the boundary duplicate ids should be rejected when building an index rather than silently overwritten unless replacement is the policy. kotlin collection chains are expressive but repeated filters or nested searches can hide multiple passes. measure representative workloads after choosing the simplest correct structure. optimisation should preserve readability and include a benchmark or test that explains why the complexity is justified. type code language kotlin code fun indexbyid expenses list expense map expenseid expense n require expenses.map it.id .toset .size expenses.size n duplicate expense id n n return expenses.associateby it.id n caption the function makes unique keys an explicit precondition before constructing the fast lookup representation. type callout tone remember title space is part of the cost text a faster lookup structure often stores an additional index. include memory construction update and correctness costs in the decision. contracts along with read only and mutable collection interfaces. title collection operations overview publisher kotlin documentation resourcetype official docs url https kotlinlang.org docs collection operations.html whyread surveys transformations filtering grouping ordering aggregation and other operations whose passes and allocations should be understood. title algorithms part i publisher princeton university resourcetype guide url https www.coursera.org learn algorithms part1 whyread offers deeper optional study of union find stacks queues sorting searching trees and hash tables. inspect title replace repeated scans with an index language kotlin code data class expense val id string val amount double nfun main n val expenses listof expense a 3.0 expense b 5.0 n val byid expenses.associateby it.id n println byid b .amount n walkthrough associateby scans the list once to construct a map. the resulting key lookup is typically constant average time. duplicate ids would overwrite earlier values so production code must decide and enforce that policy. expectedoutput 5.0 trap check mistake choosing a set when duplicate order carries meaning. why the representation silently discards information required by the domain. fix write the invariants first then select the structure that preserves them. mistake calling an algorithm o 1 because it was fast in one test. why elapsed time at one size does not describe how work grows. fix count dominant operations state assumptions and measure representative sizes. challenge intro task implement an expense collection that preserves display order rejects duplicate ids supports typical constant time lookup by id and documents the complexity of each public operation. successlookslike display order remains documents.text: http rest and json boundaries scout purpose mobile applications exchange messages with remote systems and correctness depends on understanding the protocol and treating external data as untrusted. realworlduse retrofit okhttp web apis authentication caching retries and offline synchronisation all build on http requests responses and serialised payloads. outcome describe an http exchange choose methods and interpret status families distinguish resource design from transport and validate json into domain models. learn estimatedminutes 10 sections id exchange title http is a request response protocol blocks type paragraph text an http client sends a request containing a method target uri headers and sometimes a body. a server returns a status code headers and sometimes a body. the method expresses intended semantics get retrieves a representation post commonly submits or creates put replaces at a known target patch applies a partial modification and delete requests removal. safe methods should not request state change idempotent methods can be repeated with the same intended effect though logging and timestamps may still differ. https protects the connection in transit but does not make response data truthful or application logic authorised. type code language http code get v1 expenses month 2026 07 http 1.1 nhost api.example.test naccept application json n nhttp 1.1 200 ok ncontent type application json n n items id e7 amount 12.5 caption the request target includes a path and query headers negotiate json the response status and media type describe the returned representation. type flow title http exchange steps id build label build request detail choose method uri headers and optional body. id send label send detail transport bytes over a connection normally protected by tls. id handle label handle response detail interpret status headers and body together. id map label map result detail validate transport data into an application outcome. id semantics title status and rest conventions shape behaviour blocks type paragraph text status codes are grouped by first digit 2xx reports successful handling 3xx redirects 4xx reports a request side problem and 5xx reports a server side failure. the exact code matters 201 can include the location of a created resource 204 has no response body 401 concerns authentication 403 authorisation 404 absence and 429 rate limiting. a rest style api models addressable resources and uses http semantics consistently but rest is an architectural style rather than a synonym for json. retry policy depends on method idempotency failure stage server guidance and business operation blindly retrying a payment like post can duplicate side effects. type code language kotlin code when response.code n in 200..299 decodesuccess response n 401 apiresult.authenticationrequired n 404 apiresult.notfound n 429 apiresult.retrylater response.retryafter n in 500..599 apiresult.serverfailure response.code n else apiresult.unexpected response.code n caption transport outcomes become explicit application results rather than one undifferentiated exception. type table title status families columns family meaning client question rows 2xx request handled successfully is a body expected for this exact code 3xx further redirection action should the client follow or cache it 4xx request cannot be fulfilled as sent must identity input or rate handling change 5xx server failed to fulfil a valid request is a bounded retry safe and useful id json boundary title json is syntax not a trusted domain model blocks type paragraph text json represents objects arrays strings numbers booleans and null. it does not carry kotlin types dates decimal money semantics sealed variants or
